question: Will UNRWA win the Nobel Peace Prize in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, as announced by the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

If multiple listed individuals or entities jointly receive the prize, the market will resolve to a single winner. If Donald Trump, Volodymyr Zelenskyy,  Benjamin Netanyahu, Vladimir Putin, or Elon Musk are among the recipients, the market will resolve to the highest-ranked among them in that exact order of precedence. If none of those five are among the winners and the prize is awarded jointly to at least one listed individual and at least one listed organization, the market will resolve in favor of the individual. If no prioritized individuals are among the winners and all listed recipients are of the same type (all individuals or all organizations), the market will resolve to the person whose last name, or the entity’s name, comes first in alphabetical order as listed in this market.

If no official announcement regarding the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize has been made by March 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other."

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement from the Norwegian Nobel Committee.
research:
I could find only one forecast-type figure for UNRWA, Polymarket at about 4% to 8%, and nothing has already settled the question. Most page fetches were blocked by the proxy, so several figures below come from search-result summaries of those pages rather than the pages themselves. I excluded anything published after 2026-09-23.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question is settled by the first official announcement from the Norwegian Nobel Committee (nobelprize.org). I could not fetch that site, so I have no direct status reading from it.
- 2026-04-30: Reuters reported the announcement is scheduled for **October 9, 2026**, with the ceremony on December 10. [Arab News/Reuters](https://www.arabnews.pk/world/some-287-nominated-for-2026-nobel-peace-prize-trump-likely-among-them-2641879)
- Resolution quirk: if UNRWA wins jointly with an individual on the market's list, the market resolves to the individual. If it wins jointly with another listed organization, it resolves to whichever name comes first alphabetically.

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-23, nothing settles the question. The laureate had not been announced.
- I found no public confirmation that UNRWA was nominated for 2026. Nominators may disclose their own nominations, but the committee keeps the list secret for 50 years. [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2641879)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-25: UNRWA condemned Israeli forces entering its Qalandiya Training Centre in Jerusalem. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1787690224009-a903)
- Late July 2026: In Gaza, UNRWA started summer learning for more than 39,500 children (July 18) and reopened the Beach Camp Health Centre (July 21). The same update said fighting in Gaza had escalated significantly. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1785420537808-5dce)
- 2026-04-30: The committee logged 287 nominations: 208 individuals and 79 organizations. Leaders of Cambodia, Israel and Pakistan said they had nominated Trump, and a Norwegian newspaper reported Zelenskyy was nominated. [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/04/30/norwegian-nobel-committee-logs-287-nominations-for-2026-peace-prize-trump-and-zelenskyy-among-the-nominees/)
- 2026-03-18: PRIO director Nina Græger published her personal 2026 shortlist. I could not get the names, so I can't say whether UNRWA is on it. [PRIO](https://prio.org/research/topics/nobel-peace-prize)
- March 2026: Commissioner-General Philippe Lazzarini warned that UNRWA's continued operation was in doubt because of a funding crisis. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1774016000666-5f01)
- 2026-01-20: Israeli forces demolished UNRWA's East Jerusalem headquarters, and the UN condemned it. UNRWA's 2026 flash appeal for the occupied Palestinian territory seeks US$1.26 billion. [ReliefWeb](https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/unrwa-occupied-palestinian-territory-flash-appeal-2026)
- Separately, a headline says UNRWA had "funds until end of September." I couldn't open the article to confirm its date. [The Sun MY](https://thesun.my/news/world-news/un-agency-for-palestinians-says-has-funds-until-end-of-september-af12717236/)

## 4. Base rates
- UNRWA has never won. Its only publicly confirmed nomination I found was in February 2024, by Norwegian Labour MP Åsmund Aukrust. [Israel Hayom](https://www.israelhayom.com/2024/02/02/norwegian-mp-proposes-unrwa-for-nobel-peace-prize-amid-global-criticism/), [JNS](https://www.jns.org/unrwa-nominated-for-nobel-peace-prize/)
- In 2024, media and bookmakers listed UNRWA as a possible winner alongside the ICJ and UN Secretary-General Guterres. The 2024 prize went to Nihon Hidankyo. [TBS News](https://www.tbsnews.net/world/nobel-peace-prize-could-honour-unrwa-icj-un-chief-guterres-957216)
- The 2025 prize went to María Corina Machado. [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2641879)
- From my background knowledge (not sourced here): UN bodies have won several times, including UNHCR (1954, 1981), UNICEF (1965), UN Peacekeeping (1988), the UN and Kofi Annan (2001), the IAEA (2005) and the WFP (2020). That is roughly one UN-agency win per decade. Pre-announcement favorites, especially in betting markets, have often lost.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-10: A Polymarket snapshot shown on CryptoSlate had **UNRWA at 5.3%**, behind Yulia Navalnaya (7.5%) and the International Court of Justice (5.7%), with Zelenskyy at 2.9%. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/nobel-peace-prize-winner-2026/)
- Other Polymarket snapshots (dates unclear) put UNRWA at about 4.3% to 4.9%, and an aggregator showed about 8%. [Accrue](https://accrue.com/m/will-unrwa-win-the-nobel-peace-prize-in-2026-983), [Octagon](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/awards/politics/nobel-peace-prize-winner-2026/), [Orrery](https://www.orrery.me/markets/will-unrwa-win-the-nobel-peace-prize-in-2026-983)
- A UK bookmaker reportedly listed UNRWA at 8/1, about 11% implied before the bookmaker's margin. I could not open the page to check its date. [Casino.org](https://www.casino.org/news/nobel-peace-prize-odds-predictions/)
- Early-season coverage had Trump leading the betting. [OLBG](https://www.olbg.com/news/nobel-peace-prize-2026-odds-donald-trump-leads-early-betting-market)
- I did not find a Kalshi or Manifold price specifically for UNRWA.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-09: The committee announces the prize in Oslo. [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2641879)
- Late September to early October: the PRIO shortlist and newspaper "favorite" lists are usually updated or publicized. Market prices can swing sharply in the final hours if information leaks, as happened in 2025.
- Ongoing: UNRWA's funding cliff around the end of September, Israeli restrictions on the agency, and Gaza hostilities could raise or lower the committee's interest in a humanitarian or UN-system laureate.
